classification: Present since embedded paywall callbacks were introduced.
evidence: The original native error serializer and React Native callbacks already delivered numeric `10` while the public enum defined `"10"`. Historical boundary execution reproduces both purchase and restore mismatches. Presented-paywall callbacks added in [#1958](https://github.com/RevenueCat/react-native-purchases/pull/1958) (`a91582199ff69e7431df9139556fc0057942f1e9`, 2026-10-09; first stable tag `10.13.0`) carried the same unnormalized payload; that later path was checked in source.
limitations: Native serializer/methods and actual JavaScript callback expressions executed with framework/dependency shims. No full historical mobile app was run.
